name: normify
description: Build a human-and-machine readable, fractal module tree of a codebase: zero-tolerance validation, deterministic compilation and a single-file interactive architecture diagram, plus a design-first workflow that keeps the diagram in sync with the code.
author: Moonshot AI

interface.shortDescription: Turn a codebase into a drill-down module-tree architecture diagram that stays in sync with the code.
interface.longDescription:
Normify describes a project as one fractal module tree: the model analyzes and authors structure data (module tree source files), while a deterministic engine validates, compiles and renders it — drill into any module and you get a finer-grained sub-diagram.

It is a whole workflow, not a one-shot picture generator: change_* tracking, a design-first (plan-then-code) loop, incremental resync via git diff, architecture rules enforced by policy.yml, and a single-file interactive HTML renderer (drill-down, API-level arrows, bilingual switch, deep links).
